name: Robert Callahan
original_name: ロバート・キャラハン
source:
[i]"See ya in the new year. Don't get out of shape, Ace Striker!"[/i]

A 4th year student and one of Michael's roommates. He used to be the prefect throughout his junior student days up until Michael took over the role. He's handsome and excels in both his studies and in sports. Has a strong sense of justice and speaks his mind without hesitation. Best friends with the quiet Joshua.

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
